body.statement: In a scalar locally asymptotically normal experiment with unit information, the weak limit of every regular estimator of the local parameter is the convolution of \(N(0,1)\) with a probability law; an estimator whose limit is \(N(0,1)\) attains the convolution bound.

source.verbatim_statement: Convolution theorem. Suppose that the sequence of experiments is locally asymptotically normal at θ with nonsingular information matrix I_θ, and let T_n be regular at θ with limit distribution L_θ. Then there exists a probability measure M_θ such that L_θ = N(0,I_θ^(−1)) * M_θ.

attestation.note: Verified against van der Vaart, Asymptotic Statistics, Chapter 8, Section 8.5 (Convolution Theorem), with scope cross-checked against van der Vaart own published restatement, The Statistical Work of Lucien Le Cam, Theorem 4.2. Specializing to a scalar parameter and unit information gives the node; the pure N(0,1) case is the efficient equality case.
